sources.creatures: every creature weenie (weenie.type 10, WeenieType.Creature) of the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 (ACE's open world database, the same the ground profiles' facts come from; not retail dats), read with one read-only SELECT offline through server/runtime/mariadb-ace.cnf on 2026-11-15: SELECT w.class_Id, REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(n.value, ''), '\t', ' '), '\n', ' ') AS name, COALESCE(lv.value, 0) AS level, COALESCE(v.init_Level, -1) AS health_start, COALESCE(v.level_From_C_P, -1) AS health_ranks, COALESCE(e.init_Level + e.level_From_C_P, -1) AS endurance, COALESCE(rd.value, 1) AS resist_health_drain, COALESCE((SELECT BIT_OR(b.d_Type) FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_body_part b WHERE b.object_Id = w.class_Id AND b.d_Val <> 0), 0) AS damage_types, COALESCE(md.init_Level, -1) AS defence_start, COALESCE(md.level_From_P_P, -1) AS defence_ranks, COALESCE(md.s_a_c, -1) AS defence_sac, COALESCE(fo.init_Level + fo.level_From_C_P, -1) AS focus, COALESCE(se.init_Level + se.level_From_C_P, -1) AS self FROM ace_world.weenie w LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_string n ON n.object_Id = w.class_Id AND n.type = 1 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int lv ON lv.object_Id = w.class_Id AND lv.type = 25 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute_2nd v ON v.object_Id = w.class_Id AND v.type = 1 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute e ON e.object_Id = w.class_Id AND e.type = 2 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float rd ON rd.object_Id = w.class_Id AND rd.type = 125 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_skill md ON md.object_Id = w.class_Id AND md.type = 15 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute fo ON fo.object_Id = w.class_Id AND fo.type = 5 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute se ON se.object_Id = w.class_Id AND se.type = 6 WHERE w.type = 10 ORDER BY w.class_Id;
sources.columns: wcid; name (weenie_properties_string 1); level (weenie_properties_int 25, 0 when absent); health_start and health_ranks (weenie_properties_attribute_2nd type 1 MaxHealth: init_Level and level_From_C_P); endurance (weenie_properties_attribute type 2: init_Level + level_From_C_P); resist_health_drain (weenie_properties_float 125 ResistHealthDrain, ACE's default 1 when absent); damage_types (the OR of weenie_properties_body_part d_Type where d_Val is not 0, 0 when none); defence_start, defence_ranks and defence_sac (weenie_properties_skill type 15 Magic Defense: init_Level, level_From_P_P, s_a_c); focus and self (weenie_properties_attribute types 5 and 6: init_Level + level_From_C_P); -1 where the row is absent
sources.derived: not stored: the loader computes the maximum health with GroundDraft.MaxHealthOf and the Magic Defense with GroundDraft.MagicDefenseOf (trained; M6 14 attack timing: an untrained or absent Magic Defense too, ACE's untrained use: the dats' SkillTable gives Magic Defense min level 1, so CreatureSkill.IsUsable adds round((Focus + Self) / 7) to its init_Level and ranks, CreatureSkill.cs:48-63 and 154-163), the profiles' own formulas (ACE CreatureVital.cs:104-131, CreatureSkill.cs:154-163 @95ef426d); checked at extraction against every profile max_health and magic_defence of a creature weenie (no mismatch)
sources.use: M6 14 walk drains (the owner, 2026-11-15: the target's health and kind are known data, and the server's database holds every creature): CreatureTable, read after the ground profiles by CreatureFacts.MaxHealthOf and DrainResist.Of; M6 14 the losing race: by CreatureFacts.Find, each weenie's attack for the line from the attackers present (FightLines.DeriveAttackers)
sources.attacks: M6 14 the losing race (live death 2026-11-15 04:13 UTC: 'Tuskie Gunner' 22521 had no recorded attack and the line fell to the general fallback): each creature's attack as ACE's monster damage reads it (DamageEvent.DoCalculateDamage, Monster_Melee.GetBaseDamage and GetAttackPart, Monster_Missile.GetMissileDamage, WorldObject_Weapon.GetWeaponCriticalChance and GetWeaponCritDamageMod, SkillFormula.GetAttributeMod @95ef426d), read with one read-only SELECT offline through server/runtime/mariadb-ace.cnf on 2026-11-15, joined to the rows by wcid: SELECT w.class_Id AS wcid, COALESCE(st.init_Level + st.level_From_C_P, -1) AS strength, COALESCE(co.init_Level + co.level_From_C_P, -1) AS coordination, COALESCE(bp.d_Val, -1) AS part_dval, COALESCE(bp.d_Var, -1) AS part_dvar, COALESCE(bp.d_Type, -1) AS part_dtype, COALESCE(wl.weenie_Class_Id, -1) AS weapon_wcid, COALESCE(ww.type, -1) AS weapon_kind, COALESCE(wd.value, -1) AS weapon_damage, COALESCE(wm.value, -1) AS weapon_damage_mod, COALESCE(wv.value, -1) AS weapon_variance, COALESCE(wt.value, -1) AS weapon_dtype, COALESCE(wc.value, -1) AS weapon_crit_multiplier, COALESCE(wf.value, -1) AS weapon_crit_frequency, COALESCE(ll.weenie_Class_Id, -1) AS launcher_wcid, COALESCE(lm.value, -1) AS launcher_damage_mod, COALESCE(lc.value, -1) AS launcher_crit_multiplier, COALESCE(lf.value, -1) AS launcher_crit_frequency, COALESCE(ad.value, -1) AS ammo_damage, COALESCE(av.value, -1) AS ammo_variance, COALESCE(atp.value, -1) AS ammo_dtype FROM ace_world.weenie w LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute st ON st.object_Id = w.class_Id AND st.type = 1 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute co ON co.object_Id = w.class_Id AND co.type = 4 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_body_part bp ON bp.id = (SELECT b.id FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_body_part b WHERE b.object_Id = w.class_Id AND b.d_Val <> 0 ORDER BY b.d_Val DESC, b.d_Var ASC, b.`key` ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list wl ON wl.id = (SELECT c.id FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie cw ON cw.class_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int d ON d.object_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id AND d.type = 44 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float m ON m.object_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id AND m.type = 63 WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND (c.destination_Type & 2) <> 0 AND cw.type IN (4, 6) ORDER BY COALESCE(d.value, 0) * COALESCE(m.value, 1) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie ww ON ww.class_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int wd ON wd.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wd.type = 44 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float wm ON wm.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wm.type = 63 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float wv ON wv.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wv.type = 22 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int wt ON wt.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wt.type = 45 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float wc ON wc.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wc.type = 136 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float wf ON wf.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wf.type = 147 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list ll ON ll.id = (SELECT c.id FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie cw ON cw.class_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND (c.destination_Type & 2) <> 0 AND cw.type = 3 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float lm ON lm.object_Id = ll.weenie_Class_Id AND lm.type = 63 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float lc ON lc.object_Id = ll.weenie_Class_Id AND lc.type = 136 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float lf ON lf.object_Id = ll.weenie_Class_Id AND lf.type = 147 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list al ON al.id = (SELECT c.id FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie cw ON cw.class_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int d ON d.object_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id AND d.type = 44 WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND cw.type = 5 ORDER BY COALESCE(d.value, 0) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int ad ON ad.object_Id = al.weenie_Class_Id AND ad.type = 44 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float av ON av.object_Id = al.weenie_Class_Id AND av.type = 22 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int atp ON atp.object_Id = al.weenie_Class_Id AND atp.type = 45 WHERE w.type = 10 ORDER BY w.class_Id;
sources.attack_columns: strength and coordination (weenie_properties_attribute types 1 and 4: init_Level + level_From_C_P); part_dval, part_dvar, part_dtype (the body part with the largest d_Val, weenie_properties_body_part; ACE picks among the parts with a d_Val at random, the hardest is the safe side); weapon_wcid, weapon_kind, weapon_damage, weapon_damage_mod, weapon_variance, weapon_dtype, weapon_crit_multiplier, weapon_crit_frequency (the wielded, destination_Type & 2, MeleeWeapon 6 or thrown Missile 4 with the largest Damage x DamageMod: weenie.type, weenie_properties_int 44 Damage and 45 DamageType, weenie_properties_float 63 DamageMod, 22 DamageVariance, 136 CriticalMultiplier, 147 CriticalFrequency); launcher_wcid, launcher_damage_mod, launcher_crit_multiplier, launcher_crit_frequency (the wielded MissileLauncher 3); ammo_damage, ammo_variance, ammo_dtype (the Ammunition 5 of its create list with the largest Damage); -1 where the row or property is absent
sources.attack_derived: not stored: the loader picks the hardest of the body part, the weapon and the launcher with its ammo by ACE's largest uncritical hit (DVal x DamageMod x the attribute modifier 1 + (attribute - 55) x 0.011, x 0.008 on Coordination for a launcher, SkillFormula.cs:11-23) and gives it ACE's critical: the weapon's CriticalFrequency, else 0.1 (WorldObject_Weapon.cs:292), and a critical of the largest hit x (1 + CriticalMultiplier, else 1) (DamageEvent.cs:276,287)
sources.timing: M6 14 attack timing (the owner, 2026-11-15, after the second death on the Tusker Holding's approach: the creature stats and the formulas are on hand, so every number is computed, never guessed): each creature's attack timing facts as ACE's monster AI reads them (Monster_Melee.MeleeAttack, GetCombatManeuver and DoSwingMotion; Creature_Combat.GetAnimSpeed and GetCombatStance; Monster_Combat.GetNextAttackType, NextMagicAttackTime and AttackReady; Monster_Magic.TryRollSpell, MagicAttack, PreCastMotion and GetPostCastTime; Monster_Missile.LaunchMissile @95ef426d), read with three read-only SELECTs offline through server/runtime/mariadb-ace.cnf on 2026-11-15 and joined to the rows by wcid (the weapon and launcher picked as the attacks SELECT picks them, checked equal): SELECT w.class_Id AS wcid, COALESCE(mt.value, -1) AS motion_table, COALESCE(ct.value, -1) AS combat_table, COALESCE(pu.value, -1) AS powerup_time, COALESCE(md.value, -1) AS magic_delay, COALESCE(qu.init_Level + qu.level_From_C_P, -1) AS quickness, COALESCE(hm.value, 0) AS human_magic, COALESCE(wcs.value, -1) AS weapon_combat_style, COALESCE(wat.value, -1) AS weapon_attack_type, COALESCE(lcs.value, -1) AS launcher_combat_style, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie cw ON cw.class_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND (c.destination_Type & 2) <> 0 AND cw.type = 6) AS melee_weapons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int cu ON cu.object_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id AND cu.type = 51 AND cu.value = 4 WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND (c.destination_Type & 2) <> 0) AS shields, COALESCE(wt.value, -1) AS wielded_treasure, COALESCE(wl.weenie_Class_Id, -1) AS weapon_wcid, COALESCE(ll.weenie_Class_Id, -1) AS launcher_wcid FROM ace_world.weenie w LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_d_i_d mt ON mt.object_Id = w.class_Id AND mt.type = 2 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_d_i_d ct ON ct.object_Id = w.class_Id AND ct.type = 4 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float pu ON pu.object_Id = w.class_Id AND pu.type = 34 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float md ON md.object_Id = w.class_Id AND md.type = 80 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_attribute qu ON qu.object_Id = w.class_Id AND qu.type = 3 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_bool hm ON hm.object_Id = w.class_Id AND hm.type = 7 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_d_i_d wt ON wt.object_Id = w.class_Id AND wt.type = 32 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list wl ON wl.id = (SELECT c.id FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie cw ON cw.class_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int d ON d.object_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id AND d.type = 44 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float m ON m.object_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id AND m.type = 63 WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND (c.destination_Type & 2) <> 0 AND cw.type IN (4, 6) ORDER BY COALESCE(d.value, 0) * COALESCE(m.value, 1) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int wcs ON wcs.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wcs.type = 46 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int wat ON wat.object_Id = wl.weenie_Class_Id AND wat.type = 47 LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list ll ON ll.id = (SELECT c.id FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_create_list c JOIN ace_world.weenie cw ON cw.class_Id = c.weenie_Class_Id WHERE c.object_Id = w.class_Id AND (c.destination_Type & 2) <> 0 AND cw.type = 3 ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_int lcs ON lcs.object_Id = ll.weenie_Class_Id AND lcs.type = 46 WHERE w.type = 10 ORDER BY w.class_Id; SELECT s.object_Id AS wcid, s.spell, s.probability FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_spell_book s JOIN ace_world.weenie w ON w.class_Id = s.object_Id AND w.type = 10 ORDER BY s.object_Id, s.id; SELECT sp.id, REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(sp.name, ''), '\t', ' '), '\n', ' ') AS name, COALESCE(sp.e_Type, -1) AS element, COALESCE(sp.base_Intensity, -1) AS base_intensity, COALESCE(sp.variance, -1) AS variance, COALESCE(sp.num_Projectiles, -1) AS projectiles, COALESCE(sp.boost, 0) AS boost, COALESCE(sp.boost_Variance, 0) AS boost_variance, COALESCE(sp.damage_Type, -1) AS damage_type, COALESCE(sp.source, -1) AS transfer_source, COALESCE(sp.transfer_Cap, -1) AS transfer_cap FROM ace_world.spell sp WHERE sp.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.spell FROM ace_world.weenie_properties_spell_book s JOIN ace_world.weenie w ON w.class_Id = s.object_Id AND w.type = 10) ORDER BY sp.id;
sources.timing_columns: motion_table and combat_table (weenie_properties_d_i_d 2 MotionTable and 4 CombatTable); powerup_time (weenie_properties_float 34 PowerupTime, ACE's 1 s when absent); magic_delay (float 80 AiUseMagicDelay, ACE's 3 s when absent); quickness (weenie_properties_attribute type 3: init_Level + level_From_C_P); human_magic (bool 7 AiUseHumanMagicAnimations, 0 when absent); weapon_combat_style and weapon_attack_type (weenie_properties_int 46 DefaultCombatStyle and 47 AttackType of the attacks' weapon_wcid); launcher_combat_style (int 46 of launcher_wcid); melee_weapons (the wielded, destination_Type & 2, MeleeWeapon 6 rows of its create list); shields (the wielded rows whose weenie has int 51 CombatUse 4, Shield); wielded_treasure (d_i_d 32 WieldedTreasureType: a weapon rolled at spawn); spells (its weenie_properties_spell_book rows in id order, ACE's iteration order: [spell, probability], a probability over 2 is a chance of probability - 2, else probability / 100); -1 where absent. The spell_columns and spells tables: every spell of a creature's book from the spell table (e_Type the element's DamageType bits, base_Intensity and variance the projectile's least damage and its spread, num_Projectiles, boost and boost_Variance, damage_Type, source and transfer_Cap of a transfer)
sources.timing_derived: not stored: the animation lengths and attack frames are read from the user's dats at run time (MotionTable.GetAnimationLength and GetAttackFrames over the motion table, the maneuvers from the combat table: Vitals.AttackTiming), never recorded
sources.scope: M6 item 16 E1e (2026-11-17): the table is written by the generator now (pwsh -File tools/fight-sim.ps1 bestiary; the columns are listed in tools/fight-sim/BestiaryTables.cs), which reads the same rows through ACE's own models, queries only. The SELECT quoted above is the first extraction's and takes weenie.type 10 only; the generator also takes weenie.type 15 (WeenieType.Cow), which ACE builds as a Creature subclass (Source/ACE.Server/WorldObjects/Cow.cs:7, Source/ACE.Server/Factories/WorldObjectFactory.cs:49-50 @95ef426d) that a generator places and a player can fight: the world database holds 17 such weenies (the Low B belt's cattle among them, weenie classes 20, 181 and 182). Added: their 17 rows and one spell of their books (3789); the table now holds 7,848 creatures and 1,141 spells. No other row changed (bestiary --check before the refresh: 0 with a different row). The other weenie types ACE builds as a Creature subclass are left out, each with why in tools/fight-sim/BestiaryRows.cs (AceIds.LeftOut): Vendor (1,179 weenies), CombatPet (259), Pet (29) and GamePiece (12).
sources.health: M6 item 16 E1e: the loader's maximum health is ACE's for a weenie that states no MaxHealth row or no Endurance too (CreatureTable.MaxHealthOf): a weenie with no MaxHealth row gets an empty vital (Entity/CreatureVital.cs:29-33 @95ef426d), the Endurance the formula reads is never under 1 (Entity/CreatureAttribute.cs:141-155) and the whole is never under 1 (Entity/CreatureVital.cs:167-171); the stored columns are unchanged (-1 where the weenie states no row).
